stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(ast_end,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM a WHERE kind IN ('FunctionDef','AsyncFunctionDef')

stages.name: schema_approval_entries
stages.query: SELECT CAST(key AS INTEGER) ordinal,value entry FROM schema_approval_parameters,json_each(data,'$.schemaApprovals.entries')

stages.name: schema_approval_errors
stages.query: SELECT ordinal*2 ordering,entry||': approved schema checks must not be internal impl callsites' message FROM schema_approval_entries WHERE substr(rx_extract(entry,'\A([^:]*)',1),1,5)='impl/' UNION ALL SELECT ordinal*2+1,entry||': approved schema checks must be production user-facing callsites' FROM schema_approval_entries WHERE substr(rx_extract(entry,'\A([^:]*)',1),1,8)='scripts/' OR instr(rx_extract(entry,'\A([^:]*)',1),'/tests/')>0

stages.name: schema_approval_state
stages.query: SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM schema_approval_errors) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM schema_approval_entries) OR coalesce(json_extract(data,'$.schemaApprovals.signatureVerified'),0)=1) approved FROM schema_approval_parameters
